entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-11-04
entry.content:
Azure.ResourceManager.AIInfraOptimization_1.0.0-beta.1

1.0.0-beta.1 (2026-11-04)

This is the initial public preview release of the Azure AI Infrastructure Optimization management client library for .NET.

Features Added

  • Adds synchronous and asynchronous RecommendVmSku operations for requesting VM SKU recommendations.
  • Supports the Microsoft.AIInfraOptimization service API version 2026-06-01-preview.

This package is a public preview, so expect incompatible changes in subsequent releases as we improve the product. To provide feedback, submit an issue in the Azure SDK for .NET GitHub repository.

Azure.ResourceManager.SecretsStoreExtension_1.0.0-beta.3

1.0.0-beta.3 (2026-11-03)

Features Added

  • Added support for specifying the Azure cloud using the CloudName property on KeyVaultSecretProviderClassProperties and AzureKeyVaultSecretProviderClassUpdateProperties.

Azure.Provisioning.SecretsStoreExtension_1.0.0-beta.1
